title: River belief-CFR full-breadth 8k convergence control
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Extending the exact same six public states, 48-hand ranges, and three solver seeds from 2,048 to 8,192 iterations will reduce pooled cross-seed root-strategy TV and increase greedy agreement without a catastrophic state-level reversal, confirming that the target instability is primarily solver underdose.
material_change: Add a cell-restartable immutable-artifact runner that reconstructs the prior states/ranges, exactly reproduces each 2,048 snapshot, and continues the same seeded solver trajectory to 8,192 iterations. No learned weights or new environment trajectories.
baseline: At2,048 iterations pooled TV=0.3976 and greedy agreement=0.3970; 512-to-2,048 TV slope=-0.105 with two locally non-improving states.
notes: Per-cell JSON is written atomically after a full seeded trajectory and reused on restart. Gates: exact parent 2,048 replay within1e-12 for root strategies/regret; pooled TV decreases; pooled agreement increases; no state TV worsens by >0.10 and no state agreement drops by >0.10; all integrity checks pass. No distillation regardless of outcome.

result.summary: All 18 immutable state-by-seed cells exactly replayed their parent2,048 strategies, regrets, infoset counts, and terminal-node counts before extending to8,192. Mean root regret fell from26.407 to9.353, pooled cross-seed TV fell from0.3976 to0.3276, and greedy agreement rose from0.3970 to0.4630. TV improved in every one of six states; no state exceeded the preregistered local reversal bounds. Eighteen SHA-bound cell artifacts make the run restartable and auditable.
result.conclusion: The public-belief river CFR solver remains underconverged but has now shown reproducible geometric improvement at full state/seed breadth. No strategy target is stable enough to distill; one final32,768-iteration convergence control is justified by the monotone all-state TV direction, not by absolute target quality.
result.next_step: Extend the exact same six states, ranges, and solver seeds to32,768 with per-cell durability and exact8,192 replay. Require pooled TV/agreement improvement, no catastrophic state reversal, and inspect whether the slow stability slope is sufficient to reach the original0.10/0.80 thresholds at feasible compute. If not, close this solver configuration as sample-inefficient without training any policy.
